title: Course Outline
summary: Stage 2 training covering therapist mindset, appearance, massage room tools, room readiness, client courtesy, and the pre-massage routine.

sections.title: About This Course
paragraphs: The Stage 2: Zura Wellness Professional Course builds on foundational training and deepens the therapist's practical competence across mindset, appearance, massage room readiness, client courtesy, and the pre-massage routine.
Each module includes focused topics and a clear learning outcome so therapists know what they are expected to understand and demonstrate.

sections.title: Module 1: Therapist Mindset and Professional Attitude
list: The mindset of a Zura Wellness Professional.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should develop the right attitude for long-term professional growth.

sections.title: Module 2: Therapist Appearance and Personal Presentation
list: Importance of appearance in spa service.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should understand that appearance is part of professionalism and client confidence.

sections.title: Module 3: Items and Tools in the Massage Room
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should know every item in the massage room, its purpose, how to arrange it, and how to maintain it.

sections.title: Module 4: Massage Room Preparation and Room Readiness
list: How to prepare the room before a client enters.
Final room check before session begins.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should be able to prepare a clean, calm, and professional massage room before every session.

sections.title: Module 5: Courtesy Before, During, and After Massage Sessions
paragraphs: Before the Session: Welcoming the client; speaking calmly and respectfully; confirming client comfort; explaining the session briefly; asking about pressure preference; asking about areas of pain, discomfort, or sensitivity; maintaining professional boundaries.

During the Session: Checking comfort without disturbing relaxation; adjusting pressure when necessary; avoiding unnecessary conversation; being calm and focused; respecting silence; watching client body language; maintaining professional conduct.

After the Session: Allowing client time to settle; speaking politely after the session; asking for feedback; giving simple aftercare advice; thanking the client; resetting the room immediately; reporting observations where necessary.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should know how to treat clients with courtesy from beginning to end.

sections.title: Module 6: Pre-Massage Routine
list: Checking oils, towels, tools, and bed.
Explaining what the client should expect.
sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The therapist should follow a consistent routine before every massage session.
